Icons

Source: vignettes/articles/icons.Rmd
icons.Rmd

shadshiny ships a small, curated icon set drawn from Lucide — enough to cover the components without pulling in a font or an icon package. Reference an icon by name anywhere a component takes an icon argument, or render one directly with shad_icon().

Icon names are validated. Passing a name that isn’t in the set below throws an error rather than rendering nothing, so typos surface immediately.

Using icons 

shad_icon("search")                                   # a bare 16×16 SVG
shad_button("Search", icon = "search")                # leading icon
shad_button(icon = "plus", size = "icon")             # icon-only button
shad_badge("Verified", icon = "check")                # in a badge
shad_menu_item("mail", "Send mail", icon = "mail")    # in a menu
shad_sidebar_item("inbox", "Inbox", icon = "mail")    # in the sidebar

Get the full list programmatically with shad_icon_names().

Sizing & colour

Icons inherit the current text colour (currentColor), so they tint themselves to whatever context they sit in — wrap one in a coloured element and it follows. They render at 1rem by default; to resize a standalone icon, pass an inline style through ... (it overrides the default sizing), or attach the shad-icon--sm / shad-icon--lg class.

Code
tags$span(style = "color:var(--shad-primary)", shad_icon("circle-check"))
tags$span(style = "color:var(--shad-destructive)", shad_icon("triangle-alert"))
shad_icon("loader", style = "width:2rem;height:2rem")

Missing an icon?

The set is intentionally minimal. For anything outside it, pass your own SVG (or any tag) wherever an icon argument is accepted — the constructors take a tag just as readily as a name:

custom <- htmltools::tags$svg(
  xmlns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", viewBox = "0 0 24 24",
  width = "16", height = "16", fill = "none", stroke = "currentColor",
  `stroke-width` = "2", htmltools::tags$path(d = "M12 2v20M2 12h20")
)
shad_button("Custom", icon = custom)
